```lean
CategoryTheory.LaxFunctor.map₂_associator.{w₁, w₂, v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} {B : Type u₁} [Bicategory B] {C : Type u₂}
  [Bicategory C] (self : LaxFunctor B C) {a b c d : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
  self.mapComp f g ▷ self.map h ≫ self.mapComp (f ≫ g) h ≫ self.map₂ (α_ f g h).hom =
    (α_ (self.map f) (self.map g) (self.map h)).hom ≫ self.map f ◁ self.mapComp g h ≫ self.mapComp f (g ≫ h)
```
